stories.title: French actor Gerard Depardieu to stand trial on rape charge, lawyer says
stories.summary: A Paris appeals court has ruled that French actor Gérard Depardieu will stand trial over the alleged 2018 rape of actress Charlotte Arnould at his Paris home.
